artDirection: Premium painted HD-2D fantasy tactical RPG forest threat reveal. Present the canonical forest spider as an imminent nest hazard before tactical combat. Keep the creature alive and the route unresolved; do not choreograph battle or victory.

shots.purpose: Reveal a venomous forest spider controlling the path before combat.
shots.promptIntent: The spider stays completely frozen on the right facing the offscreen party, like an unchanged painted creature cel, without advancing or enlarging. Preserve every creature pixel position, exact canonical identity, leg count, leg positions, anatomy, silhouette, color, scale, facing, and ground contact. Animate only foliage, waterfall mist, and atmospheric light. No leg motion, attack, web projectile, extra spiders, dead creature, destroyed nest, party character, combat result, text, or UI. End sharp at unchanged scale.
